trim.selection: Measured warm seconds saved per byte (2026-11-01/02). No tail table: the complete zero tail table (40.6 MB) saves the 5L zero run ~35 s end to end, but a controlled A/B (two native 5L quadratic runs at the same time on the same CPUs, with and without it) showed it slows the quadratic run by more than 780 s (its modular replay), so no tail table is shipped. The support-5 route shard measured no saving and is not shipped. Quadratic shards: per-phase saving of each shard (cold vs warm, quadratic, 8 threads, quiet CPUs) x its quadratic-only share of records, per added byte (at most 0.21 s/MB); best taken greedily within the budget.
